BASE=$(.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main) || BASE=""

TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/run-jq.sh -r '.comment.id // empty' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true)
echo "from-event=[$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID]"
if [ -z "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" ]; then
  TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1544/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null || true)
fi
echo "resolved=[$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID]"
